guard.reason: Reordering onboarding steps, including moving sign-in after pet selection, is explicitly permitted under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Deferring auth until after value/pet selection builds user motivation.

candidates.change: Display a dynamic wait estimate timer and rotating tips carousel while pet assets are being generated.

components.label: Select Quick Adopt vs Custom Creation

candidates.title: Photo upload quality tips and preview guide
candidates.change: Add photo guidelines and advice component on upload_photos screen to help users provide clear inputs.
